mechanism_claim: The 'freshness' component is redundant with existing momentum/time features (mom_20, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20) and captures no independent signal; it is a relabeled proxy for recent price action quality that is already encoded in the selected_winner profile.
evidence_for: Selected winners show mom_20 median of 0.163 vs false negatives 0.058 (standardized_delta=-1.0005), directly encoding 'how much recent acceleration occurred'
Selected winners show up_day_ratio_20 median of 0.625 vs false negatives 0.50 (standardized_delta=-1.1882), encoding 'freshness of directional bias'
Selected winners show ma10_slope_5 median of 0.027 vs false negatives 0.012 (standardized_delta=-0.6815), encoding 'current momentum velocity'

Cases like entity_ead73f4390 (selected_winner, mom_20=0.320, up_day_ratio_20=0.70) and entity_2f86543bf6 (selected_winner, mom_20=-0.008, up_day_ratio_20=0.35) show winners span a range that 'freshness' would flatten, suggesting the feature aggregates rather than distinguishes
The base_duration_weeks contrast (median_delta=-8.0) implies setups that consolidate longer are worse—a temporal effect already partially captured by ma_slope features during the base period
evidence_against: entity_8ad5cd4795 (selected_winner, mom_20=0.004, ma10_slope_5=-0.006, up_day_ratio_20=0.70) is a winner despite weak momentum, possibly indicating a distinct 'freshness' signal from a new base start rather than momentum magnitude
pullback_pct standardized_delta=+0.6404 (false negatives less deep) suggests 'time since pullback' may encode recovery freshness not fully captured by forward-looking slope features

ruin outcomes include cases like entity_6618d3e80c (selected_winner|false_positive_ruin, mom_20=0.251) where high momentum coexists with ruin, implying momentum and freshness may operate in different causal pathways
The feature set lacks an explicit 'days since breakout trigger' variable, which could be the unique 'freshness' signal distinct from ongoing momentum measures
falsifiable_predictions: If freshness is redundant: regression of outcome on (mom_20 + ma10_slope_5 + up_day_ratio_20) will absorb >90% of the variance explained by any freshness proxy constructed from these features
If freshness is unique: adding a 'days_since_ibd_entry_trigger' variable (PIT-observable) will significantly improve classification AUC beyond the existing feature set, with effect size >0.03

If freshness proxies freshness: among entities with identical mom_20 and up_day_ratio_20, those with lower base_duration_weeks will show higher selected_winner rate (specificity test for temporal independence)

Falsification criterion: if Pearson correlation between freshness_score and first principal component of (mom_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20) exceeds 0.85, declare redundancy confirmed
policy_implications: If redundancy confirmed: drop freshness as an independent component; weight its proxy features individually to allow heterogeneous contribution to portfolio construction
If freshness is unique: replace with a cleaner metric: 'trading_days_since_ibd_trigger_entry' (integer, PIT-observable, no lookback bias) rather than a composite of lagged features
If ambiguous: use freshness as a secondary filter (e.g., freshness_score < threshold) rather than a primary feature, reducing its leverage on model decisions while preserving optionality
Avoid 'freshness_score' as a derived composite; instead require PIT-observable atomic features that independently pass the redundancy test
